patch_description: Revert the pre-entanglement RZ layer that increased parameter count without benefit (score dropped from 0.63 to 0.58 when added), and restore the parameter-sharing CRZ pattern that achieved the best prior score (0.63). Additionally, insert a lightweight RY "refresh" layer on qubits [1,3,5,7] between the CRZ entangling block and the final RZ readout layer, as suggested. This adds only 4 new parameters/gates, giving the circuit a second amplitude-mixing stage before the final phase rotations, which may help stabilize convergence and slightly improve expressivity without significantly increasing overfitting risk (unlike the heavier rz_pre layer which hurt generalization).
